items.claim: Golf kinematics research uses inconsistent methods, and 3D approaches are commonly required for joint rotation analysis; universal 2D normal ranges are not supported.
items.applicability: Supports conservative interpretation of 2D body-pose observations. Does not validate this app's estimator or numeric thresholds.

citation.title: Golf Swing Biomechanics: A Systematic Review and Methodological Recommendations for Kinematics

items.claim: A sagittal single-camera study found repeatability of forward tilt useful for proficiency analysis while club trajectory required a separate club-head detector.
items.applicability: Limited to 2D observations under comparable capture conditions; it does not make wrist-center path a club path.

citation.title: Extracting proficiency differences and individual characteristics in golfers' swing using single-video markerless motion analysis

items.claim: Evidence linking golf-swing biomechanics and lower-back pain is limited and heterogeneous.
items.applicability: The app may surface observation candidates but must not diagnose injury risk from a single 2D video.

citation.title: Biomechanical parameters of the golf swing associated with lower back pain: A systematic review

items.claim: Club path, attack angle, speed, face angle and dynamic loft depend on three-dimensional club-head and impact-location measurements.
items.applicability: These values must not be inferred from body pose or wrist-center path alone.
